Test Case Name: Verify eligible CMW Strata product availability
Description: Validate that CMW Strata is available for an eligible risk
Action: 1. Start a new policy transaction; 2. Enter an eligible strata risk; 3. Select an eligible jurisdiction building type and transaction type [TBD]; 4. Open product selection
Expected Result: CMW Strata is displayed and available for selection

Description: Validate that the user can start the CMW Strata workflow
Action: 1. Select CMW Strata; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The CMW Strata workflow opens with strata building exposure and coverage sections displayed

Description: Validate acceptance of a valid strata corporation name
Action: 1. Open the strata information section; 2. Enter a valid strata corporation name; 3. Leave the field
Expected Result: The name is accepted and no validation error is displayed

Description: Validate acceptance of building address type construction age and unit count
Action: 1. Enter a valid building address; 2. Select an eligible building type and construction type; 3. Enter valid year built; 4. Enter a valid number of units
Expected Result: The building information is accepted and saved

Test Case Name: Enter valid occupancy and unit mix
Description: Validate acceptance of valid occupancy and unit-mix information
Action: 1. Enter valid occupancy details; 2. Enter the applicable unit mix; 3. Continue
Expected Result: Occupancy and unit-mix data are accepted without validation errors

Description: Validate acceptance of replacement cost common property amenities parking utilities and loss-prevention data
Action: 1. Enter valid building replacement cost; 2. Enter applicable common-property and amenity details; 3. Enter parking utility and loss-prevention information
Expected Result: The exposure information is accepted and available for rating

Description: Validate selection of an allowed property coverage and limit
Action: 1. Open coverage options; 2. Select a permitted property coverage [TBD]; 3. Select an allowed property limit [TBD]
Expected Result: The property coverage and limit are selected and displayed

Description: Validate selection of an allowed liability coverage and limit
Action: 1. Open liability coverage options; 2. Select an allowed liability limit [TBD]
Expected Result: The liability coverage and limit are accepted and displayed

Test Case Name: Select deductible extension exclusion and endorsement
Description: Validate configured optional CMW Strata selections
Action: 1. Select an allowed deductible; 2. Select an extension exclusion or endorsement [TBD]; 3. Complete any dependent fields
Expected Result: The selections are applied and dependent fields appear when configured

Description: Validate premium calculation using valid building exposure location and coverage data
Action: 1. Complete valid strata and building data; 2. Select permitted coverages; 3. Click Quote
Expected Result: The system calculates and displays the configured premium applicable charges and total

Test Case Name: Save and resume CMW Strata transaction
Description: Validate persistence of valid strata information and coverage selections
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Click Save; 3. Navigate away; 4. Reopen the transaction
Expected Result: All saved strata details exposures and coverage selections are retained

Test Case Name: Complete approved CMW Strata policy workflow
Description: Validate bind and issue after validations and approvals pass
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Quote the policy; 3. Complete required approvals; 4. Bind and issue
Expected Result: The policy is bound and issued with the correct status details and coverage selections

Description: Validate product eligibility for an unsupported risk
Action: 1. Start a new transaction; 2. Enter an ineligible building type operation or jurisdiction [TBD]; 3. Open product selection
Expected Result: CMW Strata is unavailable or the configured eligibility message is displayed

Description: Validate required-field behavior for strata corporation name
Action: 1. Open an eligible transaction; 2. Leave strata corporation name empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: A field-level validation message is displayed and progression is blocked

Description: Validate required-field behavior for building address and jurisdiction
Action: 1. Complete other building fields; 2. Leave building address empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The address field is flagged and progression is blocked

Description: Validate configured construction eligibility rules
Action: 1. Select an unsupported construction type [TBD]; 2. Complete remaining required data; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The unsupported construction is rejected or referred according to configuration

Description: Validate required-field behavior for unit count
Action: 1. Complete other building information; 2. Leave number of units empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The unit-count field displays a validation message and progression is blocked

Test Case Name: Reject invalid occupancy or unit mix
Description: Validate that inconsistent occupancy and unit-mix data is rejected
Action: 1. Enter an invalid or inconsistent occupancy and unit mix [TBD]; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The inconsistent data is rejected and the configured validation message is displayed

Description: Validate required replacement-cost behavior
Action: 1. Complete building and exposure information; 2. Leave replacement cost empty; 3. Click Quote
Expected Result: The replacement-cost field is flagged and quoting is blocked

Description: Validate configured replacement-cost and valuation rules
Action: 1. Enter an invalid or out-of-range replacement cost [TBD]; 2. Click Continue or Quote
Expected Result: The value is rejected and the configured validation message is displayed

Test Case Name: Reject unavailable coverage limit or deductible
Description: Validate that unconfigured coverage values cannot be submitted
Action: 1. Attempt to select an unavailable limit or deductible [TBD]; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The invalid selection cannot be submitted and a validation message is displayed

Test Case Name: Block quote when required data is incomplete
Description: Validate that incomplete strata or CGL data prevents quoting
Action: 1. Complete only part of the required transaction data; 2. Click Quote
Expected Result: Field-level validation messages identify missing information and no quote is completed

Test Case Name: Create underwriting referral for qualifying risk
Description: Validate referral behavior for a configured strata risk condition
Action: 1. Enter building exposure claims or loss information that meets a referral rule [TBD]; 2. Click Quote or Bind
Expected Result: The system creates the configured referral displays its status and prevents completion

Description: Validate that an unresolved referral blocks binding
Action: 1. Create a qualifying underwriting referral; 2. Leave it unresolved; 3. Click Bind
Expected Result: Binding is blocked and the required referral action is displayed

Description: Validate the configured minimum unit-count boundary
Action: 1. Enter the minimum valid number of units [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The minimum valid unit count is accepted

Description: Validate lower-bound behavior for number of units
Action: 1. Enter a unit count below the configured minimum [TBD]; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The value is rejected and a range validation message is displayed

Description: Validate the configured maximum unit-count boundary
Action: 1. Enter the maximum valid number of units [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The maximum valid unit count is accepted

Description: Validate upper-bound behavior for number of units
Action: 1. Enter a unit count above the configured maximum [TBD]; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The value is rejected and a range validation message is displayed

Description: Validate the configured minimum replacement-cost boundary
Action: 1. Enter the minimum valid replacement cost [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Click Quote
Expected Result: The minimum valid replacement cost is accepted and rating can proceed

Description: Validate the configured maximum replacement-cost boundary
Action: 1. Enter a replacement cost above the configured maximum [TBD]; 2. Click Continue or Quote
Expected Result: The value is rejected and a range validation message is displayed

Description: Validate that dependent fields appear when an amenity or common-property answer requires details
Action: 1. Select an amenity or common-property option that triggers additional information [TBD]; 2. Observe the form
Expected Result: The dependent fields appear and are marked required when configured

Description: Validate dependent-field behavior when the triggering answer changes
Action: 1. Trigger an amenity or common-property field; 2. Enter a value; 3. Change the answer so the field is not applicable
Expected Result: The dependent field is hidden or disabled and its value is cleared or ignored according to configuration

Description: Validate recovery after invalid strata data is corrected
Action: 1. Submit incomplete or invalid data; 2. Correct each highlighted field; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: Validation messages clear and the workflow proceeds successfully

Description: Validate that saved strata and coverage data can be updated
Action: 1. Open a saved transaction; 2. Change a building or coverage value; 3. Save; 4. Reopen the transaction
Expected Result: The updated value is saved and displayed in the relevant section

Test Case Name: Attach correct CMW Strata documents after quote
Description: Validate document attachment based on coverage jurisdiction transaction and effective date
Action: 1. Complete valid CMW Strata data; 2. Quote the policy; 3. Open the document list
Expected Result: Required CMW Strata forms schedules endorsements disclosures and supporting documents are attached with the correct version and effective date

Description: Validate document generation during policy issuance
Action: 1. Complete validations and approvals; 2. Issue the policy; 3. Open generated documents
Expected Result: Required issued-policy documents are generated and correct form editions are displayed

Description: Validate retention of strata details exposures changes referrals approvals rating inputs and documents
Action: 1. Save a transaction; 2. Change a strata or coverage value; 3. Create and resolve a referral; 4. Open transaction history
Expected Result: The audit history displays relevant changes rating inputs referrals approvals and generated documents
